newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firms on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firms on tight liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah firmed against the dollar in slow early trading on Wednesday.
Dealers said rates were trapped in a range between 2,427.0 and 2,429.0, although the rupiah was in a strengthening trend.
"Trading is better than Tuesday but volume remains low. In fact the general view hasn't changed yet, with offshore slightly long in rupiah forwards," one Singapore bank dealer said.
The dealer said he preferred to go short on dollars in the spot market while remaining outright in the very short-term.
Spot rupiah was at 2,427.50/27.75 at 0245 GMT against an opening of 2,428.0/29.0.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,427.25/27.50 and 2,426.75/27.25, respectively.

"You see the rupiah hardly touched the 2,430.0 level this week. Had we established short dollar positions last week, we would have been able to cash out from the gains and weekend premiums," the dealer said.

Dealers said trading on Wednesday was mainly driven by relatively tight liquidity in the money market. Overnight money was traded at 13.0/14.0 percent. They said the tight market caused some pressure on spot dollars.
The Singapore bank dealer said the overall view in the forward market remained the same, with offshore investors holding long rupiah positions and trying to take profits when possible.
Dealers were mixed over the impact of the weakening dollar against the yen on dollar-rupiah rates.

One U.S. bank dealer said some seemed to attribute the dollar-yen falls to the strengthening of the rupiah but others were looking at the impact on Indonesia's budget which would be begative if the yen continues to rise.
Indonesia has set a dollar-yen exchange rate at 110 for its 1997/98 budget starting April.
The dollar slipped to its lowest level against the yen in almost seven months on Wednesday, sinking to 110.97 yen.
"The view from dollar-yen is mixed. But the fact is that the dollar-rupiah rate is more driven by liquidity," the U.S. bank dealer said.
Overnight swap was at 0.4/0.6 and tom/next at 0.22/0.24.
One-month swaps were at 12.25/13.25, two at 25.0/27.0, three at 39.0/40.0 and six at 77.5/79.0 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,419/2,611 and its conversion band at 2,419/2,467 on Tuesday.
